assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:garfiel-tinsel@light-novel#character-model, the canonical derived-use model REZERO_GARFIEL_TINSEL_V10_V15_CHARACTER_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese main light novels V10-V15. The project's CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md and 05 Character Analysis README were read for method, authority order and scope only. The separate same-analyst fidelity review, the frozen V10-V15 readings, the master and five owner ledgers, the Arc 4 checkpoint, the reconstruction protocol, the source lock and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's MONOGRAPH_READY and PASS_WITH_BOUND labels and its HIGH and MEDIUM confidence tags are inputs, not conclusions. No V16 or later volume, web novel, IF, supplement or anime material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Garfiel's states from the represented pre-trial childhood and the early Sanctuary protector phase (E013 through E017 as analytical loop states) through the E018 sequence of suspicion, defeat, renewed first trial, outside defense and settlement, with the model's default being living E018 at the V15 month-later party with Frederica. The model's declared horizon is V10-V15; V16 and later states, which the project has since admitted, are expressly not established here, and every default-state use must name that horizon. No in-world calendar dates are fixed, and the Ram chronology the project marks OPEN is not resolved.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1's thesis (protection that can open a way or become a wall), section 4's seven contextual priorities each paired with what prevents universalizing it, twenty-eight eight-field conditional rules with exceptions, and section 11's ten rival readings with live discriminators form a rule-level inferential model built on thirty-three located bundles. Counterweights: a single same-analyst artifact; the model states that the exact weighting of unspoken motives is its weakest area; HIGH and MEDIUM are internal evidence judgments, not tested probabilities.

Section 2 defines seven selector axes and ten phase or event selectors from represented childhood to the default party, with a memory firewall that keeps the E015-E017 deaths and killings as Subaru's and the analyst's knowledge rather than Garfiel's, and a rule that scene time is not source ceiling. The horizon ends at V15, the childhood is represented through the trial only, and the party-month quantities are unknown.

Section 9 records about eighteen located forms with their functions across V10-V15: 俺様 and its fracture to 俺 in the mother disclosure, てめェ and 三下, 大将 for Subaru after the first pass, ババア and 婆ちゃん, 姉ちゃん and 姉貴, 母さん, エミリア様, 誓え and 今ここで, proverbs, elongated vowels, and the human-speech-versus-roar channel distinction. It generates no Japanese dialogue as canon and prescribes JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW for unsampled politeness or vocabulary. No sentence-final inventory, frequency data or extended-speech model exists, and anime delivery is excluded.

Section 6 lists about eighteen located ordinary rows (early sleeping and waking among elders, chair care, dislike of fallen-leaf tea, reported bandaging, broad reading, unread letters, shield-play, the formal-clothes struggle, the checked drink attempt, the withheld pie preparation), each with what remains unavailable, and names favorites, money, routine, sleep hours and alcohol rules as active unknowns. Scenes are scattered across six volumes and most are single observations.

Section 7 gives thirteen recipient rows with likely strategy and nontransfer controls, multi-scene for Ram, the real Frederica, Subaru, Otto, the particular grandmothers and Roswaal, and separates the trial Frederica from the real sister and ordinary copies from the named grandmothers. Garfiel-side only; Rem, Petra, Meili and Patrasche rest on one or two scenes.

E018 own focalization (B013), the mother disclosure in his own words (B017), the 俺様 to 俺 fracture, and section 8.1's table of sincere but mistaken self-assertions give located interior evidence. The model marks maternal motive, the function of the scar and any trauma reading as underdetermined and refuses diagnosis; interior claims are scene-specific.

Rules R01, R07, R10, R12, R19, R23 and R26 cover intrusion response, coercive detention, reaction to Subaru's self-risk, beast use under lethal pressure, divided rescue, conditional mercy followed by killing, and the oath settlement, each with adverse cases (E015 murders, E016 copy expenditure). Post-V15 conflict is outside the set.

Located moral choices in his own terms: refusing Subaru as bait while spending copies (B010), distinguishing defeat from agreement (B019), answering Roswaal for himself (B023), conditional mercy (B030), and the oath demand with a for-now concession (B032); rules R08, R16, R23 and R26 keep the selective kinship ethic and coercion visible. No procedure for an unfamiliar moral dilemma is supplied, and the model refuses a fixed triage ranking.

Proverbs and dramatic idioms used for challenge, comic mismatch and tactical framing, sibling teasing and mock pride, the critical grin learned from Subaru and Otto, and the party drink scene are located (B001, B006, B024-B027, B033). Humor is a recurrent verbal resource rather than a sampled repertoire of jokes.

Section 3.1 fixes six locked EPUBs by hash and reconciles forty-six bounded Japanese windows plus the frozen readings' Garfiel claims, stating that this is not six fresh complete rereads. The horizon is V10-V15 of a continuity whose project spine has moved past it; earlier volumes do not concern him, but the declared boundary excludes later admitted material and the separate review.

Nineteen negative controls, ten rival readings with discriminators, section 8.1's mistaken self-assertions and the section 0.1 correction of an inherited source-identity error (Frederica's speaking feline misattributed to Garfiel) are affirmative, located constraints. All sit inside one artifact with the project's own review.

Event-state binding to analytical loop states, a default fixed to his latest actual scene rather than the reader-only coda, explicit prohibitions on back-writing later insight or source facts into earlier horizons, and the memory firewall are explicit. The horizon lag to the project's current spine and the OPEN Ram chronology bound it.

conditions: Written Japanese register only, as section 9 defines it; no anime delivery, prosody or audiovisual staging.
The speaker is human or partial-form Garfiel; full-tiger speech is not generated, and Frederica's V11 feline speech is never routed to him.
The interlocutor is an attested recipient in an attested phase, with the address the model supports for that relation (大将 only after the first pass, 姉ちゃん to the real sister).
Content, recipient and phase are selected before orthographic imitation; unsampled politeness or vocabulary ends in JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW rather than invention.
Output is noncanonical reconstruction output and is never cited as evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: The forms are diagnostic and located but short; the model itself generates no canon dialogue.

conditions: Chronology is one named V10-V15 state, by default living E018 at the V15 party; no V16 or later, IF, web-novel or anime state is used, and the horizon is stated.
Knowledge is limited to section 8.1: no E015-E017 memories, no RBD, tea, confidential bargain, soul procedure, terrace or coda receipt.
The interlocutor is an attested recipient in an attested relation, or an unsupported new person handled by R28 with abstention on trust, office and history.

The situation matches the classes the seven probe pairs and the rules cover (intrusion, protective requests, mundane help, same-face search, patron confrontation, party drink, bodily form); output is a behavioral tendency with the model's HIGH or MEDIUM label, and UNKNOWN is a stop.
The section 0.1 correction is enforced, and no readiness is inherited from the model's MONOGRAPH_READY or PASS_WITH_BOUND labels.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V10-V15 state, by default living E018 at the V15 month-later party after his own first trial pass, the outside defense and the for-now oath settlement; earlier states only when explicitly selected with their own knowledge and resources.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Ram, the real Frederica, Subaru, Otto, the particular Ryuzu representatives, Emilia, Roswaal, Petra, or Elsa and Meili in combat, each in its attested register; strangers only under R01, R04 and R28 with abstention on trust and office.
setting_constraints: Sanctuary, the Roswaal mansion, the outside fight or the household party as narrated
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V10-V15 corpus
Human, partial or full-beast form selected explicitly with its resource limits
UNKNOWN and ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Section 12 supplies seven probe pairs as an application protocol, but they were assessed only by the same analyst's nonblind documentary review, which lies outside this evidence set.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: elder care, reading, sibling teasing and correction, community stewardship, formal dress, the party drink attempt, letters.
Favorites, money, routine, sleep hours and alcohol rules end in abstention; Otto's drunkenness is not transferred to Garfiel.
Rough speech is kept with the care it accompanies; neither is generalized into a global harmless or hostile reading.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6 supports a modest ordinary baseline with explicit unknowns.

conditions: Only the attested classes: protecting versus confining, using or sparing a particular person, accepting correction without surrendering judgment, demanding a commitment from a patron, and conditional mercy toward a lethal enemy.
The selective kinship ethic (named grandmothers versus ordinary copies) and his coercive tendencies remain in force; no reformed universal ethic is supplied.
A triage or ranking the source does not give (P03B) ends in abstention, and no clinical diagnosis or prognosis is produced.
scenario_readiness.note: Several moral positions are argued in his own words, but the model declares his valuations not narrator-certified and gives no general deliberation procedure.

conditions: Garfiel-side only, with Ram as recipient in an attested phase (E013-E018); her explicit refusal of marriage, independent commitments and ability to fight him are retained.
Attraction is expressed through boasting, worry, argument and a wish for reassurance, not reciprocal intimacy; her lap and promised comfort are not consent.
Elsa's possessive profession is never reciprocated, and no later romantic state is asserted.
scenario_readiness.note: The pursuit is multi-scene and located (B006, B008, B016, B019, B021) but one-sided; the model's control N11 forbids inferring acceptance.

conditions: Attested roles only: local shield and steward, temporary captor as an adverse case, apostle command in its demonstrated scenes, chosen outside defender and task division under R19 and R25.
Commander is not employment, sovereignty or unlimited obedience; the welfare condition on cooperation stays live.
Resources follow the scene: no infinite earth aid, refill or eyesight-range attack.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 8.2 separates competence from institutional permission; his roles are relational, not offices.

known_limits.statement: The model declares its horizon as V10-V15 and its default as the V15 party, forbids retrofitting later source into that horizon and states that later Garfiel maintenance must name new admitted evidence; the default is therefore the end of this evidence set, not the continuity's latest state.

The model records its fidelity state as PASS_WITH_BOUND, same analyst, nonblind, documentary, with no held-out, runtime or global grade, and sets do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority to true as a derived-use artifact subordinate to the frozen readings and the Japanese source.

Section 0.1 corrects an inherited misattribution: the V11 speaking, partly healing full feline is Frederica; Garfiel's full tiger lacks reason in V13 and reverts to human before speech in V15. Any Garfiel full-form speech or healing claim built on the inherited label is invalid.

Current Garfiel does not remember the E015 killings, the E016 death or the E017 Ram treatment, and lacks RBD, private bargain, soul procedure, terrace and coda knowledge; section 8.1 governs what he can know.

Maternal fate and motive, the fathers' lives, the function of the scar, the weighting of unspoken motives, exact alcohol and other ordinary-life facts, and whether the new distribution of protection holds under future failure remain open in the model's own terms.

The separate fidelity review, the frozen V10-V15 readings, the ledgers, the protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated on this subject, and the project's later admitted volumes containing Garfiel material lie outside this set; none was used, and missing support is not evidence of absence.
